mapper.sql: ,DECODE(D.JOB_COLUMN, 'STATUS', '상품상태' , 'DESCRIPTION_LOC', '품목명' , 'MODEL_INFO', '모델번호' , 'SPECIFICATION', '규격' , 'MAKER_CODE', '제조사' , 'ORIGIN_CODE', '원산지' , 'ORDER_MEASURE', '단위' , 'ITEM_GUBUN', '상품구분' , 'TR_HANDLE_TYPE', 'TR취급가능여부' , D.JOB_COLUMN) AS JOB_COLUMN_NM /* 변경항목 */ ,CASE D.JOB_COLUMN WHEN 'STATUS' THEN DECODE(D.OLD_DATA, 'D', '미사용', '사용') WHEN 'ITEM_GUBUN' THEN DECODE(D.OLD_DATA, 'G', '표준품', '비표준품') WHEN 'MAKER_CODE' THEN (SELECT MK.TEXT1 || ' (' || D.OLD_DATA || ')' FROM ICOMCOD1 MK WHERE MK.TYPE = 'M104' AND MK.CODE = D.OLD_DATA) WHEN 'ORIGIN_CODE' THEN (SELECT OG.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 OG WHERE OG.TYPE = 'M001' AND OG.CODE = D.OLD_DATA) WHEN 'TR_HANDLE_TYPE' THEN (SELECT TR.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 TR WHERE TR.TYPE = 'M181' AND TR.CODE = D.OLD_DATA) ELSE D.OLD_DATA END AS OLD_TEXT /* 기존 */ ,CASE D.JOB_COLUMN WHEN 'STATUS' THEN DECODE(D.NEW_DATA, 'D', '미사용', '사용') WHEN 'ITEM_GUBUN' THEN DECODE(D.NEW_DATA, 'G', '표준품', '비표준품') WHEN 'MAKER_CODE' THEN (SELECT MK.TEXT1 || ' (' || D.NEW_DATA || ')' FROM ICOMCOD1 MK WHERE MK.TYPE = 'M104' AND MK.CODE = D.NEW_DATA) WHEN 'ORIGIN_CODE' THEN (SELECT OG.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 OG WHERE OG.TYPE = 'M001' AND OG.CODE = D.NEW_DATA) WHEN 'TR_HANDLE_TYPE' THEN (SELECT TR.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 TR WHERE TR.TYPE = 'M181' AND TR.CODE = D.NEW_DATA) ELSE D.NEW_DATA END AS NEW_TEXT /* 변경 */
